description_zh: 创建 Supabase 项目分支
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb create-branch --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --project-id spb-xxxx --parent-branch-id br-main --branch-name dev --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateBranch

parameters.help_en: The region ID. This parameter is required when you create a primary branch. When you create a child branch, the region is inherited from the primary branch by default
parameters.help_zh: 地域 ID。创建主分支时必须指定，创建子分支时默认继承主分支所在地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Supabase project that corresponds to the primary branch
parameters.help_zh: 主分支对应的 Supabase 项目 ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent branch. This parameter specifies the parent branch for the new branch or query condition
parameters.help_zh: 父分支 ID，用于指定新分支或查询条件的上级分支
parameters.name: parent_branch_id

parameters.help_en:
The initialization source of the branch.

Valid values:
ParentData: copies the schema and data from the parent branch. This is the default value.
SchemaOnly: copies only the schema structure
parameters.help_zh:
分支初始化来源。

取值：
ParentData：复制父分支的 Schema 和数据，默认值。
SchemaOnly：仅复制 Schema 结构
parameters.name: init_source

parameters.help_en:
The point in time for data synchronization when creating a branch from the parent branch. The value is in the ISO 8601 UTC format.

Default value: the current time
parameters.help_zh:
从父分支创建分支时选择的数据同步时间点，格式为 ISO 8601 UTC 时间。

默认值：当前时间
parameters.name: parent_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The log sequence number (LSN) selected when creating a branch from the parent branch
parameters.help_zh: 从父分支创建分支时选择的 LSN
parameters.name: parent_lsn

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable branch protection.

Valid values:
true: Enables branch protection.
false: Disables branch protection. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启分支保护。

取值：
true：开启分支保护。
false：关闭分支保护，默认值
parameters.name: protected

parameters.help_en: The time when the branch automatically expires and is deleted. The value is in the ISO 8601 UTC format
parameters.help_zh: 分支过期自动删除时间，格式为 ISO 8601 UTC 时间
parameters.name: expires_at

parameters.help_en: The client idempotency token. This token ensures the idempotence of retry requests
parameters.help_zh: 客户端幂等令牌，用于保证重试请求的幂等性
parameters.name: client_token

BranchId.description_en: The branch ID, which uniquely identifies a Supabase branch
BranchId.description_zh: 分支 ID，用于唯一标识一个 Supabase 分支

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the Supabase project that corresponds to the primary branch
ProjectId.description_zh: 主分支对应的 Supabase 项目 ID
